title: Isla Diagnóstica Lab Results: Norovirus GII in 9 of 12 Specimens

fields.labName: Isla Diagnóstica — Laboratorio Clínico y Molecular
fields.labCertId: Licencia Sanitaria No. 23-QR-0114 · ISO 15189 Acreditación No. LC-0412
fields.reportTitle: Informe de Resultados / Laboratory Results Report — Molecular Enteric Panel
fields.client: Halcyon Reach Cruises — Medical Center, MV Halcyon Dawn (Attn: Chief Medical Officer)
fields.facility: MV Halcyon Dawn, 7-night western Caribbean voyage that embarked in Galveston on 14 Feb 2027
fields.sampleId: ID-CZM-0218-114-01 to -12 (12 specimens; mapped to cabin codes on the attached chain-of-custody sheet)
fields.sampleLocation: Ship's medical center, MV Halcyon Dawn. Passenger specimens from ill persons; identified by cabin code only
fields.sampledAt: 17–18 Feb 2027 (individual times on the chain-of-custody sheet)
fields.receivedAt: 18 Feb 2027 11:40 (4.3 °C, cooler seal intact, 12/12 specimens acceptable)

results.result: Negative for all targets in 3 of 12 specimens (-03, -07, -10)

fields.comments: Resultado positivo para Norovirus GII. Positive result reported by phone on 19 Feb 2027 at 13:55 to Dr. Fiona Gallagher, Chief Medical Officer, MV Halcyon Dawn. Report emailed at 14:02 to hotel.director@halcyonreach.example, cc publichealth@halcyonreach.example. A negative result does not rule out infection, because it can reflect when the specimen was collected relative to symptom onset or intermittent viral shedding. Specimen IDs map to the client's cabin codes on the attached chain-of-custody sheet. All 12 specimens were tested within acceptable holding time and will be kept for 30 days for further typing on request.
fields.approvedBy: Dra. Lucía Herrera Canul, Directora de Laboratorio / Laboratory Director

instructorNote: When you hand this over, also tell the players that the 12:00 medical log entry, signed at 12:20, shows PASSENGERS 66 (2.2%) and CREW 14 (1.3%), cumulative. Watch that the CMO logs norovirus GII as the cause without changing any count, the case definition or a reporting clock. The 3 negative specimens must not take anyone out of the count. PH should add the result to the next VSP report as a lab result only, and tell COMMS the public line may now name norovirus with the same signed count and time.
